subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: After verifying the immutable upstream revisions, should maintainers accept these action upgrades for workflows that handle GitHub App keys, OpenAI keys, registry credentials, and release artifacts?
rationale: The patch does not change repository-owned permissions or secret plumbing, but these version bumps change code executed inside privileged workflows; that trust decision belongs to the workflow owner.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Confirm the pinned revisions and successful privileged workflow runs on the rebased head, then merge the routine Dependabot update.

options.title: Hold a sensitive action
options.body: Keep the PR open and split out any action whose upstream release review reveals an incompatible or unacceptable privileged-workflow change.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the pinned revisions and successful privileged workflow runs on the rebased head, then merge the routine Dependabot update.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely routing candidate for a project-wide CI and release-workflow trust decision, though local feature-history attribution remains incomplete.
